_comment: Bible des objets. Un objet que le recit fait traverser tout le jeu doit
avoir la meme forme d'une image a l'autre : l'Anneau de Cuivre revient
dans 23 pages, les Amulettes sont le but de la quete. Meme regle et meme
palette que les trois autres bibles.

characters.look: THE COPPER RING: the ring ALONE as an object on the plain black background -- no hand, no finger, no wearer: a plain ORANGE-copper band, its flat face marked with a single engraved arrow that always points north.
THE MASTERS' AMULETS: flat SILVER-WHITE discs on a fine chain, each cut into the shape of its owner's creature -- wolf, flower, bird, spider, frog. The Masters' fates hang on them.
THE ANTHERICA: a lush bush of dark GREEN leaves hung with clusters of small VIOLET berries; a single berry is the size of a thumbnail.

THE MAGIC STONES: precious CUT GEMSTONES that fit in a closed fist -- faceted like jewels, sharp polished facets catching the light, never smooth river pebbles. Each gem is a single flat colour -- ORANGE, GREEN, BLUE, VIOLET or WHITE -- with a bright glow at its core and WHITE facet highlights. They crumble to dust once used.
